web_metadata.name: COVID-19 immunotherapy A mathematical model
web_metadata.description: We propose a within-host population (ODE) innate immunity model, whose focus is on NK cells and their relevant role in preventing COVID19 from progressing to the acute phase that may eventually lead to the patient’s death. We propose a immunotherapy treatment.

revisions.comment:
The model was updated, on the advice of the referees, correcting some of the parameters and two differential equations of the primitive model, namely equations (19) and (22).

The preprint is available from the URL
https://www.cmup.pt/bibcite/reference/6814
Center of Mathematics University of Porto, Portugal
And is submitted to Mathematical Medicine and Biology Journal
https://academic.oup.com/imammb
